# ZzFXM (vendored)

Source: https://github.com/keithclark/ZzFXM
License: MIT (see `LICENSE`), Copyright (c) Keith Clark and Frank Force.
Vendored: 2026-11-03, from `master`.

`zzfxm.js` here is the repo's `zzfxm.js` plus the sample generator out of
its `zzfx.js`. The player (`zzfxP`) and the module-load `AudioContext`
were removed; `zzfxM` returns the sample arrays and this app encodes them
to WAV. Nothing else was changed.
